purpose: Mandate item 7: audit the prior Stage75 cisTarget engineering BEFORE writing replacements, and document exactly what is reused versus rewritten.

no_prior_sharding_or_merge_exists_in_thi.claim: No prior work in this repository sharded cbust/motif scoring or merged partial cisTarget databases, and no merge-validation logic for a motif axis exists anywhere in its history.
how_established: git grep over ~400 commits for concat/merge feather, partial db, shard motif, combine rankings
git grep -l for the DB-builder symbols across EVERY branch tip
no_prior_sharding_or_merge_exists_in_thi.consequence: The shard and merge-validation layer must be written here. It will be the first tested code in this area.
no_prior_sharding_or_merge_exists_in_thi.prior_extent_of_thinking: An observation on record that 'the scoring phase is embarrassingly parallel across motifs'. An observation, not an implementation.

the_upstream_tool_ALREADY_shards.claim: create_cistarget_motif_databases.py natively supports deterministic partial runs.
the_upstream_tool_ALREADY_shards.evidence: --help exposes `-p CURRENT_PART NBR_TOTAL_PARTS`: 'Divide the motif list in a number of total parts (of similar size) and score only the part defined by current_part ... while still being able to give the same list of motifs to each instance.'
the_upstream_tool_ALREADY_shards.why_this_matters: Sharding does NOT need to be invented. This was invisible to a repository-only audit because the tool is container-only and is not vendored into the repo.
the_upstream_tool_ALREADY_shards.what_is_still_mine_to_write: Independent merge VALIDATION. The upstream combiner is not trusted blindly: this lane must separately prove the merged motif axis equals the frozen ordered universe with no duplicates and no omissions.

cbust_invocation_is_per_sequence.relevance: Per-sequence padded background and no global normalisation flag. This is what made union scoring plausible; it was then PROVEN empirically in V69_UNION_REGION_SCORE_EQUIVALENCE_V1.json rather than assumed.

upstream_tool_pinned_by_content_not_by_c.problem: docker/scenicplus/Dockerfile clones create_cisTarget_databases at CREATE_CISTARGET_DATABASES_REF=master, an UNPINNED ref, and the resulting clone in the image carries NO git metadata, so the exact upstream commit cannot be recovered from the image.
upstream_tool_pinned_by_content_not_by_c.severity: Reproducibility hazard. Rebuilding the image at a later date would silently pick up a different tool version.
upstream_tool_pinned_by_content_not_by_c.mitigation_applied: The tool is pinned by CONTENT digest instead, which is stronger than a ref.
upstream_tool_pinned_by_content_not_by_c.recommendation_for_the_owner: Pin CREATE_CISTARGET_DATABASES_REF to an explicit commit in docker/scenicplus/Dockerfile. Not changed by this lane, because altering the recipe would invalidate the relationship to the already-validated running image.

reusing: read_columns(database, indices) -- feather.read_table(memory_map=False, use_threads=False); the OOM-safe bounded read
find_num_columns(database) -- exponential-then-binary search on column index, avoids reading the schema of a multi-GB feather
build_region_index(...) -- atomic tmp-then-replace sidecar with an ordered column_name_sha256
verify_column_parity(source, other, ...) -- positional name comparison between the scores and rankings axes
reused_code_from_prior_work.why: verify_column_parity is precisely the scores-vs-rankings axis guard required by amendment 2, and column_name_sha256 is the nearest existing thing to a frozen-axis certificate.
reused_code_from_prior_work.NOT_reused: Its pass/fail gate keys off cfg['regulators']['primary_passed_all_stage74_gates'], which is the Stage75 TF list (IRF8, STAT1). That is legacy biology and is stripped.

reusing: read_motif_ids(...) -- raises if the motif list is empty or contains duplicates; the only existing motif-axis integrity check in the repo
read_rankings_subset(...) -- requires requested indices sorted and unique, re-verifies schema names positionally element by element, checks row count and integer dtype
completed(paths) plus a summary JSON carrying "complete": true -- the shard-idempotency idiom
reused_code_from_prior_work.why: The completion-sentinel idiom generalises from per-TF batches to per-motif shards and directly satisfies the requirement that an incomplete shard be impossible to mistake for a complete one.
reused_code_from_prior_work.NOT_reused: Everything organised around `tf` as a first-class key, load_motif_annotations(specie=...), and the four hard-coded annotation columns.

reusing: the low-memory gate idea: do not open a multi-GB Arrow file unless explicitly asked
reused_code_from_prior_work.NOT_reused: Its SHA-1 manifest handling. Upstream aertslab manifests use SHA-1; this lane pins SHA-256 throughout and the two must not be mixed.

reusing: the flag combination memory_map=False, use_threads=False, which is what fixed the OOM
reused_code_from_prior_work.status: Superseded by the audit script above. Value is historical: it documents that memory_map=True plus full-schema enumeration is what ran out of memory.

reused_code_from_prior_work.why_not: It streams a 10x HDF5 CSC expression matrix, not cisTarget data, and relies on resizable 1-D HDF5 datasets. Arrow IPC is not append-resizable, so the idiom does not transfer to feather shards. Recorded so a later reader does not assume it was applicable.
reused_code_from_prior_work.also: GSE174367-specific hard-coding throughout (microglia_label 'MG', Cell.Type / SampleID column names).

reusing: ordered_digest(items) -- order-sensitive digest helper, applied to certifying the frozen motif axis

rewritten_rather_than_reused.shard_driver: No prior equivalent exists. Forked from scripts/v69/build_custom_cistarget_db_v1.sh, preserving its two baked-in defect fixes: the helper must be invoked as a SUBPROCESS not sourced (S11), and the motif list and digest must be named after the run not a fixed shared path (S12).
rewritten_rather_than_reused.merge_validator: No prior equivalent exists anywhere in the repository. The invariant to enforce, which has never been enforced here: concat(shard motif axes) in shard order EQUALS the frozen ordered motif universe, with equal length, zero duplicates and a matching ordered digest; and every shard's region axis identical to the shared region FASTA's.

configs/stage75f_out_of_core_v1.yaml.why: Saturated with superseded authorities and Stage75 biology.

specific_values_rejected.parameters.motif_count_per_batch: 5876 -- the OLD motif authority; this lane uses an independently pinned 10,249-motif collection
specific_values_rejected.cistarget_global_region_count: 1837304 -- the OLD generic hg38 screen universe; this lane builds a CUSTOM database over ~150k of its own regions
specific_values_rejected.descriptive_secondary_hypotheses: [ELF1, RELA, BACH1, NRF1, SPI1, CEBPA, STAT3, MITF]

configs/stage75f_out_of_core_v1.yaml.permitted_use: Schema template only. No value inherited from regulators, tiers or parameters.

results_explicitly_NOT_inherited.stage75f_result_tables: results/tables/stage75f_* and the preserved copies are RESULTS. Every row carries validated_regulation=False. Not inherited.
results_explicitly_NOT_inherited.generic_databases: hg38_screen_v10_clust.regions_vs_motifs.{rankings,scores}.feather are a different object from the custom database being built here.

test_coverage_of_prior_work.finding: None of the six prior cisTarget/out-of-core scripts has a test.
test_coverage_of_prior_work.consequence: Every primitive lifted from them is re-tested here rather than trusted.

prior_defects_that_multiply_under_shardi.defect: Editing a shell script in /workspace while a container executed it made bash resume at a stale byte offset.
prior_defects_that_multiply_under_shardi.amplification: With N concurrent shards executing the same worktree script, the exposure multiplies.
prior_defects_that_multiply_under_shardi.rule: Copy the script to a run-specific immutable path and execute the copy.

prior_defects_that_multiply_under_shardi.defect: A fixed-path provenance file in a shared output directory is a mutable variable, not a record.
prior_defects_that_multiply_under_shardi.amplification: With N shards writing into one directory this is the DEFAULT failure mode.
prior_defects_that_multiply_under_shardi.rule: Every digest file is named after the artifact it certifies, including the shard id.

prior_defects_that_multiply_under_shardi.carried: The 53 regions absent from the reference remain STRUCTURALLY_UNSCOREABLE: never in an enrichment denominator, never encoded as zero. Region counts are 150,614 in the cisTopic matrix and 150,561 in the cisTarget universe.
